verdict.rationale: Ramp's docs describe approval routing built into invoice-to-pay workflows (ramp-docs-2), and a community user confirms one-click approval and fund transfer for expense/travel purchases (ramp-comm-2), suggesting one-click approve/send capability exists. However, there is no explicit documentation of configurable approval-permission roles or admin controls letting a finance-lead designate specific teammates as approvers. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on setting approval hierarchies/permissions, admin UI walkthrough for assigning approver roles, and independent verification of one-click payment approval beyond a single anecdote.
